I would like to thank the Commissioners for giving me a chance to make a difference in this community. I joined the Game Staff team back in Season 1 and have thoroughly enjoyed my time on Game Staff as a Streamer, Referee, Stats Nerd, and especially as a Caster. I joined the Staff team soon after, and was incredibly grateful to be accepted to the position of Assistant Commissioner following the end of Season 2, and when we split the Staff team into departments, I took on the positions of Head of Rules and Regulations as well as Head of Games and Schedules.
